review_candidates.title: Engineer, Google Cloud
review_candidates.description: Do you have extensive hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and other Google Services ? Drive cloud innovation and service excellence, shaping reliable, high-performing services that transforms the cloud experiences across the University. Flexible location offered at Burwood or Geelong Campus + hybrid work arrangements Full-time and continuing $110,171 - $121,309 (HEW 7) + 17% Superannuation About The Role The Engineer, Google Cloud supports the delivery and optimisation of Google Cloud and Google Services across the University. The role coordinates Google Service provisioning, configuration and continuous improvement, ensuring solutions are reliable, compliant, efficient and aligned with governance standards. It works independently with technical teams and stakeholders to integrate services, improve platform performance, reliability, and customer experience. As An Engineer, Google Cloud, You Will Analyse complex cloud environment to understand the functional design. Identify opportunities for improvement and implement change through appropriate channels Ensure cloud environment compliance and availability. Prioritise work and evaluate progress to deliver outcomes Provide constructive feedback to support team capability Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships Ensure clarity of roles, responsibilities and expectations within teams Seek and respond to feedback to improve services Contribute to planning and delivery aligned to priorities To Be Successful, You’ll Have Degree with substantial relevant experience, extensive technical/administrative management expertise, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. Proven experience delivering and building complex cloud environments, particularly using Google Cloud Platform (GCP), with AWS/Azure experience desirable. Strong Python development skills, particularly in creating scripts and Cloud Functions, with the ability to develop complex and effective cloud guardrail systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to coordinate or lead complex work and influence stakeholders. Ability to work independently and perform system administration across Google services, including GCP, Workspace, Play Console, My Business, Search Console, Analytics, and Tag Manager. Here's How To Apply Only people with the right to work in Australia may apply for this position. Please submit your updated resume and a short cover letter outlining your skills and experience by clicking ‘Apply Now’. Benefits for working with us! At Deakin, we offer more than just a job - we offer a lifestyle. Across our campuses in Geelong, Melbourne, and regional Victoria, you’ll find everything you need to thrive: on-site childcare, gyms, medical centres, cafes, accessible public transport, and convenient parking. Enjoy flexible working arrangements that support your work-life balance, generous leave entitlements including extended parental leave and the option to purchase additional time off, plus a wide range of staff discounts on travel and more. Our health and wellbeing services, ongoing professional development opportunities, and inclusive, supportive culture make Deakin a place where you can grow - whether you're working remotely or immersed in the vibrant energy of campus life. Make an Impact with Us Together we aim to take Deakin forward, strengthening our progressive University through the digital work we do. Whether it's empowering students, enabling teaching staff, or supporting researchers, the work you do here matters. Your achievements contribute to making a positive difference in the lives of the people and communities we serve. So that you can focus on making a positive impact, Deakin Digital Services lays the foundations for you to be your best self, grow and evolve and work with exceptional people. Be Your Best Self As a unique person we understand that showing up as the best version of yourself takes commitment to your personal wellbeing. That’s why we foster a supportive environment where you can manage your work to balance your productivity, engagement and wellbeing. Our approach to flexible working empowers you to achieve your best. Grow & Evolve Being in the higher education sector, ours is an environment of knowledge sharing and seeking. review_candidates.title: Sales Architect / Outbound Product Management Lead
review_candidates.description: Description Leidos is seeking an experienced Sales Architect / Outbound Product Management Lead to serve as the strategic bridge between our solution portfolio and the market. This is a Senior Director enterprise-wide role responsible for partnering with capture, business development, and engineering teams to shape winning solutions while also owning outbound product strategy — positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution — for a cross-sector portfolio of offerings. This individual will operate at the intersection of technical solutioning and product marketing: translating complex mission and business requirements into differentiated, sellable solutions, and ensuring the sales force, partners, and customers clearly understand the value those solutions deliver. The role requires deep credibility with both engineering and sales stakeholders, executive presence with customers, and the judgment to prioritize investments across a diverse, cross-sector opportunity pipeline. Given the sensitivity and scope of programs supported, candidates must hold or be able to obtain an active Secret clearance. Primary Responsibilities Serve as the primary technical and strategic point of contact between Product Management, Engineering, and Sales/Capture teams for solution architecture and offering roadmaps across Leidos business sectors. Lead outbound product activities, including positioning, messaging, and go-to-market planning for new and existing solution offerings. Design end-to-end solution architectures that align customer mission requirements with Leidos capabilities, reusable IP, and partner technologies. Act as technical subject-matter expert and executive-level spokesperson in customer engagements, industry days, and proposal orals. Develop and deliver sales enablement materials — white papers, battlecards, demos, and technical proposal content — to arm the sales force and partner community. Partner with capture managers to shape technical win themes, support proposal development, and author technical volumes for RFP/RFI responses. Define and track outbound performance metrics (pipeline conversion, solution adoption, competitive win rate) and use data to refine positioning and roadmap priorities. Conduct competitive and market analysis to identify differentiation opportunities and inform investment decisions across the solution portfolio. Mentor and provide technical/strategic guidance to solution architects, product managers, and business development staff across sectors. Represent Leidos externally at industry forums, customer conferences, and partner events as a thought leader on the solution portfolio. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, and 12+ years of relevant experience in solution architecture, sales engineering, product management, or business development; equivalent combination of education and experience considered. Demonstrated experience bridging technical solutioning with go-to-market/product marketing functions. Proven track record supporting large government or commercial capture efforts, including proposal development and executive-level customer presentations. Strong understanding of solution architecture principles, technology roadmaps, and competitive positioning. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience developing sales enablement and proposal content. Active Secret clearance or ability to obtain one. Willingness to travel up to 25% to support customer engagements, proposal efforts, and industry events. Preferred Qualifications Master's degree (MBA or technical) preferred. Experience across multiple Leidos-relevant markets (defense, intelligence, civil, or health). Prior experience in a formal Product Management or Solution Architect role with P&L or roadmap ownership. Familiarity with capture and proposal frameworks (e.g., Shipley) and CRM/pipeline tools. Existing relationships with government or commercial customers relevant to Leidos' target markets. If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares. Original Posting September 1, 2026 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above. Pay Range Pay Range $139,100.00 - $251,450.00 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline onlyand not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. About Leidos Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com. Pay And Benefits Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits. Securing Your Data Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos.com. If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission. review_candidates.title: Manager, FP&A
review_candidates.description: Job Type Full-time Description LOCATION: This position is remote, but must be located in one of the following states: Texas, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Missouri, Ohio, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee or Virginia. Clearwave Fiber, a 100% Fiber Optic Internet provider offering business, enterprise, and residential communications services, is expanding its network across the Midwest, Northeast, Mid-Atlantic, and Southeast. Formed from the merger of Point Broadband and Clearwave Fiber, the company is backed by GTCR and Berkshire Partners. Our team of more than 700 colleagues is committed to delivering the most advanced technology and customer service. Job Description Clearwave Fiber is seeking a Manager, FP&A and Reporting to own the company’s recurring financial and operating reporting end to end. The role sits under the Vice President, Finance, manages the FP&A Reporting Analyst, and is accountable for the monthly reporting cycle, the planning calendar, and the systems and data flows that produce management, Board, sponsor, and lender reporting. This is a build role. The company is standing up a single reporting stack across two legacy platforms, and the reporting that exists today is too manual to scale. The successful candidate will replace manual rekeying with defined, repeatable refresh workflows, set the definitions behind reported metrics, and get the cycle to a state where a competent analyst can refresh the full package without reverse-engineering it. Ownership of the outcome matters more than years of tenure. Duties & Responsibilities Own the monthly reporting cycle end to end, including the management reporting package, Board and sponsor reporting, and the supporting variance commentary. Own the planning calendar and the planning system of record, including input collection, version control, and department-level budget and forecast review. Build and maintain automated data flows across the ERP, planning, and BI environments so recurring reporting refreshes on a defined workflow rather than manual rekeying. Own operating metric reporting, including subscribers, passings, penetration, ARPU, churn, and headcount, with documented definitions and a single source of truth for each. Produce departmental budget-to-actual reporting and support department heads on forecast accuracy and cost control. Manage, review, and develop the FP&A Reporting Analyst / Associate, including quality control over their output before it reaches senior audiences. Apply modern AI tooling, including Claude, to automate reporting, documentation, and quality checks. Requirements Minimum Qualifications: 5+ years of progressive FP&A, financial reporting, or corporate finance experience, including direct ownership of a recurring monthly reporting cycle. Hands-on ownership of a planning or reporting system such as TM1, Anaplan, Adaptive, or Pigment, and of a BI environment such as Power BI or Tableau. Consuming reports built by others is not the same as owning them. Demonstrated record of building or rebuilding a reporting or planning process end to end, rather than maintaining one that was inherited. Advanced Excel, including the ability to build and audit reporting workbooks and models that others can follow without explanation. Experience managing, reviewing, or directing the work of at least one analyst, with accountability for the accuracy of their output. Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, engineering, or a related quantitative field. Ability to hold multiple close and reporting deadlines at pace without loss of accuracy, and accountability for numbers presented to management, the Board, and sponsors. Clear written communication, including the ability to explain a variance in terms an operator can act on. Preferred Qualifications Experience at a private equity-backed or capital-intensive business, particularly fiber, cable, telecom, or other infrastructure. Working knowledge of NetSuite, TM1, and Power BI. Experience with lender, covenant, or securitization reporting, including data tape preparation. Experience consolidating reporting across two systems or entities following a merger. Familiarity with subscriber-based operating metrics and roll-forward reporting.
